fields.ownerEngagementNarrative: We treat owner communication as part of the operating system, not an add-on. Institutional owners receive the same GOP flash and covenant monitoring rhythm their lenders expect—schedules are agreed up front, and variance is explained with options, not excuses. Family offices get a plainer cadence: named regional leads, short weekly summaries, and direct access to finance when FX or working capital moves. We do not bury bad news in appendices; if Chilean peso or Argentine payment timing shifts cash, you see it in the same week with a mitigation plan. For investors and brand partners reviewing us later, the through-line is discipline: thresholds, names, and dates—so diligence is faster because the data room is already organized the way your counsel asks for it.
fields.idealProjectsAdditionalNotes: Prefer assets with clear GOP history or defensible proforma.
fields.ov_card_commercial: Commercial decisions tie to GOP truth: group pace on an honest horizon, transient BAR tied to comps, and promos that show expected margin trade—not just occupancy lifts. Sales incentives align with owner cash, not vanity top line. When we propose packaging or discounting, owners see channel cost and loyalty load—not a narrative that collapses in diligence.

fields.ownerEngagementNarrative: Our owners are often families who built one hotel and then another—they do not want jargon; they want someone who picks up when the generator fails. We structure engagement around named regional leads, WhatsApp for urgent ops (with boundaries), and monthly financials that reconcile to what the bank sees. For institutional co-investors, we add covenant monitoring and the same storm-season flash cadence we use ourselves. Brand partners get QA calendars aligned to hurricane prep, not just brand standards in a binder. We believe transparency is how you earn repeat mandates in the Caribbean: say what broke, what it cost, and what we changed so it does not happen twice.
fields.idealProjectsAdditionalNotes: Prefer assets with clear GOP history or defensible proforma.
fields.ov_card_commercial: Commercial rhythm ties leisure pace and city corporate demand to GOP: group pace on a horizon owners can sell against; transient BAR with promo rules that show margin trade. Sales leaders co-own forecasts with GMs—no revenue story that operations cannot staff.
